data.name: Deidre
data.gender_notes: Deidre is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Daidro,' meaning 'child of God.' In Greek mythology, Daidalos was a skilled craftsman and artist. The name Deidre carries the same divine connotation. The name Deidre carries the meaning “Child of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Deidre usually hope their child will grow to embody child of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in faith.
data.etymology: Deidre belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Child of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deidre total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: דידרה
in_hebrew.meaning: דידרה משמעות שם נגזרת מיוונית עתיקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דידרה נגזרת מהמילה היוונית העתיקה 'דידרא', שפירושה 'עצבוני' או 'כעוס'. השם דידרה מופיע בתרגומים של הברית החדשה ובמסורות הנוצריות. הוא קשור לתכונות אישיות כמו עצבנות ורגישות רגשית.

in_greek.name: Δείδρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Δείδρα προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική λέξη 'δίδρα', που σημαίνει 'θυμός' ή 'κατάθλιψη'. Ο όρος σχετίζεται με την πνευματική κατάσταση της λύπης και της αγωνίας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Δείδρα συμβολίζει την εσωτερική αναζήτηση και την πνευματική αγωνία.

in_latin.name: Deidre
in_latin.long_meaning: Deidre originates from the ancient Greek term 'δίδρα', which translates to 'sorrow' or 'anxiety'. In early Christian tradition, the name Deidre signified emotional depth and spiritual introspection. It was associated with individuals of contemplative and sensitive nature.

in_english.name: Deidre

data.spiritual_significance: The primary spiritual meaning behind the name Deidre is the 'Child of God.' Deidre embodies the idea that every person is a unique creation of God, endowed with God-given talents and abilities. This name serves as a reminder to strive for excellence and creativity in all aspects of life, drawing inspiration from the divine power and love that created each of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Deidre is an Irish name meaning "sorrowful". It is a variation of the name Deirdre, a mythological figure in Irish legend who was famed for her great beauty and tragic love story. Deidre's name symbolizes the deep emotions and passions that can bring both joy and sorrow.

historical_references.reference: The name Deidre has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Deidre remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
